name: AUTHORIZED
source:
crl v1
package example
bundle example.record

rule allow
	target example.record
	collector registry registry api from /evidence/registry.json
		signal approved bool from approved ttl 30d
	need approved == true
	quorum registry

name: numeric reference
source:
crl v1
rule receipt
target delivery
collector warehouse source api from warehouse.receipts
signal shipped number from shipped ttl 1d
signal received number from received ttl 1d
need received >= shipped
